assertion_analysis.fails_if: Station tick invokes no sweep or multiple sweeps, or the actual sweep reports a review error.

The dispatch branch is removed, emits zero or multiple reviews, fails to persist dispatched state, disagrees between pointer and report, skips launcher execution, or creates a non-review pointer; the report/pointer equality is between two outputs and is supplemented by the fixed cardinality and role checks.
Fixture isolation is broken or the delivery is already merged/promoted before the station acts; these are preconditions.

Promotable acceptance handoff is disabled, the queued kind is wrong, the service fails to consume the request or work remains after 90 seconds; reinstating the missing handoff fails line 82 in the recorded mutation.

The service writes no promoted receipt, reports no actual merge, leaves the feature commit absent, drops the introduced feature content, loses acceptance provenance or fails to commit section closure; the literal feature content independently checks more than commit ancestry.
The clean delivery does not queue or the fixture review is not at the required score floor; the all-20 comparison verifies setup and is not counted as regression coverage.
The queued request is not consumed or the service fails to finish within its bound.

A blocking review is ignored and acceptance proceeds, the feature lands despite the finding, ledger promotion occurs or the source pointer is retired; the literal base content and empty ledger assertions observe independent durable outcomes.

assertion_independence: No added assertion derives its expected behavioral result from a value it passes directly to the function under test; fixture RUN constants identify which run must undergo an independently observed transition.
call_sites_note: No production caller reaches the added test-only definitions; the existing runtime route exercised by them is recorded separately.
